comparison: Judge supported business reasoning and actual behavior. Accept concise equivalent valid answers, not keywords, answer length or similarity to a reference patch.

criteria.requirement: Use actual upsert_all with an explicit text primary-key schema and input validation. Reruns must avoid duplicates, update supplied quantity and retain omitted memo on existing rows. Explain new-row NULL and avoid replace semantics that erase memo.

Distinguish a proposed plan from executed migration. Include backup/verification, existing-schema checks and source-dependent recovery of lost data; do not promise whole-stream atomicity or automatic retyping.
